experiment_data.hypothesis: Test whether finetuned Qwen3-8B models can self-calibrate via entailment-based self-judgment (ESJ): does the model's P(yes) for verifying its own extracted entities correlate with entity correctness? Replaces Qwen2.5-7B ESJ probe to match the main experiment's finetuned model.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/struct_self_consist_ie && python -u code/run_esj.py --base_model_path checkpoints/qwen3-8b-scierc-merged-v2 --data_path output/scierc_mf4v2_seed42/samples.jsonl --output_dir output/esj_qwen3_scierc_seed42 --batch_size 32 && python -u code/run_esj.py --base_model_path checkpoints/qwen3-8b-conll2003-merged --data_path output/conll_mf4v2_seed123/samples.jsonl --output_dir output/esj_qwen3_conll_seed123 --batch_size 32 && python -u code/run_esj.py --base_model_path checkpoints/qwen3-8b-fewnerd-5epoch-merged --data_path output/fewnerd_mf4v2_seed42/samples.jsonl --output_dir output/esj_qwen3_fewnerd_seed42 --batch_size 32"
